name: Godly Woman
overview: A godly woman is characterized by her reverent fear of the LORD, which surpasses outward beauty and fleeting favor, and is esteemed far above precious jewels. She trusts wholeheartedly in the Lord rather than relying on her own understanding, demonstrating wisdom and kindness in her speech. Her life reflects a Spirit-led walk that resists fleshly desires, and she honors God through her faithful submission within the marriage relationship, as fitting in the Lord.
